per_step.command:
cat << 'EOFSCRIPT' > /app/evaluation.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Evaluate student submissions using grading rubric
SUBMISSIONS_DIR="${1:-student_submissions}"
RUBRIC_FILE="${2:-grading_rubric.txt}"
PASSING_GRADE="${3:-70}"
GRADES_FILE="grades.txt"

echo "=== Grading Rubric ==="
cat "$RUBRIC_FILE"
echo ""

# Clear grades file
> "$GRADES_FILE"

passing_count=0
total_students=0

# Process each student submission
for submission in "$SUBMISSIONS_DIR"/*.txt; do
    if [ -f "$submission" ]; then
        student_name=$(basename "$submission" .txt)
        total_students=$((total_students + 1))
        
        # Simulate grading based on content analysis
        content=$(cat "$submission")
        
        # Initialize scores
        creativity=0
        technical=0
        clarity=0
        guidelines=0
        
        # Evaluate Creativity (30%)
        if echo "$content" | grep -qi "creative\|innovative\|unique"; then
            creativity=25
        elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "good\|decent"; then
            creativity=20
        else
            creativity=15
        fi
        
        # Evaluate Technical Skill (40%)
        if echo "$content" | grep -qi "well-structured\|excellent\|robust"; then
            technical=35
        elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "functional\|works"; then
            technical=30
        else
            technical=25
        fi
        
        # Evaluate Clarity (20%)
        if echo "$content" | grep -qi "clear\|well-explained"; then
            clarity=18
        else
            clarity=15
        fi
        
        # Evaluate Guidelines (10%)
        if echo "$content" | grep -qi "guidelines\|requirements"; then
            guidelines=10
        else
            guidelines=8
        fi
        
        # Calculate total grade
        total_grade=$((creativity + technical + clarity + guidelines))
        
        # Check if passing
        if [ "$total_grade" -ge "$PASSING_GRADE" ]; then
            passing_count=$((passing_count + 1))
            status="PASS"
        else
            status="FAIL"
        fi
        
        # Record grade
        echo "$student_name: $total_grade/100 ($status)" >> "$GRADES_FILE"
        echo "Graded $student_name: $total_grade/100 ($status)"
    fi
done

# Calculate passing rate
if [ "$total_students" -gt 0 ]; then
    passing_rate=$((passing_count * 100 / total_students))
    echo ""
    echo "=== Summary ==="
    echo "Total Students: $total_students"
    echo "Passing Students: $passing_count"
    echo "Passing Rate: $passing_rate%"
    echo ""
    
    # Check accreditation requirement
    if [ "$passing_rate" -ge 85 ]; then
        echo "✓ ACCREDITATION REQUIREMENT MET: Minimum 85% passing rate achieved"
    else
        echo "✗ ACCREDITATION REQUIREMENT NOT MET: Passing rate below 85%"
        echo "  Committee investigation may be triggered."
    fi
fi
EOFSCRIPT
